body.x: Keizus(www.keizus.com) presented 'Quadropod and Clamp' at '2014 International CES', the biggest ITappliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Quadropod legs and arms are connected via ultra flexible ball joints that are completely detachable from the body. And The Clamp’s width can be adjusted to accommodate devices of various thickness in the range of 7mm to 13mm. Merged them, can be used for comfortable screen positioning, stable picture taking, video shooting, time-lapse photography and more.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
